import json, sys, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone

event = json.load(sys.stdin)
tool_input = event.get("tool_input") or {}
if tool_input.get("subagent_type") != "reviewer-qwen":
    print(json.dumps({"decision": "allow", "reason": "validation hook not applicable"}))
    raise SystemExit(0)

wd = pathlib.Path(event.get("working_dir") or os.getcwd()).resolve()
tmpdir = wd / ".agents_tmp"
plan_path = tmpdir / "PLAN.md"
intake_path = tmpdir / "INTAKE.json"
out_path = tmpdir / "VALIDATION.json"

def deny(reason):
    print(json.dumps({"decision": "deny", "reason": reason}))
    raise SystemExit(0)

if not plan_path.is_file():
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: PLAN.md missing")
if not intake_path.is_file():
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: INTAKE.json missing")

text = plan_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
plan_sha = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

try:
    intake = json.loads(intake_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
except Exception as ex:
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: invalid INTAKE.json: " + str(ex))

def section_entries(title):
    m = re.search(r"(?ms)^# " + re.escape(title) + r"\s*\n(.*?)(?=^# |\Z)", text)
    if not m:
        return []
    values = []
    for line in m.group(1).splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith("- "):
            value = line[2:].strip().strip("`").strip()
            if value:
                values.append(value)
    return values

mutable = section_entries("Mutable paths")
forbidden = section_entries("Forbidden paths")
if not mutable:
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: # Mutable paths is empty")

for item in mutable + forbidden:
    if any(ch in item for ch in "*?[]"):
        deny("authoritative validation cannot run: mutable/forbidden paths must be literal, not globs")
    if item.startswith("/") or ".." in pathlib.PurePosixPath(item).parts:
        deny("authoritative validation cannot run: mutable/forbidden paths must be safe workspace-relative paths")

begin = "<!-- VALIDATION_SPEC_BEGIN -->"
end = "<!-- VALIDATION_SPEC_END -->"
if text.count(begin) != 1 or text.count(end) != 1:
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: plan must contain exactly one validation spec block")

chunk = text.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
left = chunk.find("{")
right = chunk.rfind("}")
if left < 0 or right <= left:
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: validation JSON object missing")

try:
    spec = json.loads(chunk[left:right + 1])
except Exception as ex:
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: invalid validation JSON: " + str(ex))

commands = spec.get("commands")
if not isinstance(commands, list) or not (1 <= len(commands) <= 20):
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: commands must contain 1..20 entries")

blocked_patterns = [
    r"(^|[;&|]\s*)sudo\b",
    r"\bgit\s+push\b",
    r"\bgit\s+reset\s+--hard\b",
    r"\bgit\s+clean\s+-[^\n]*[fd]",
    r"\brm\s+-rf\s+/(?:\s|$)",
    r"\.agents_tmp/(?:PLAN\.md|VALIDATION\.json|INTAKE\.json)",
]

results = []
overall = "PASS"

for index, item in enumerate(commands, start=1):
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        deny(f"authoritative validation cannot run: command {index} is not an object")
    command = item.get("command")
    expected = item.get("expected_exit_code")
    timeout = item.get("timeout_seconds")
    if not isinstance(command, str) or not command.strip():
        deny(f"authoritative validation cannot run: command {index} is empty")
    if not isinstance(expected, int):
        deny(f"authoritative validation cannot run: command {index} expected_exit_code must be integer")
    if not isinstance(timeout, int) or not (1 <= timeout <= 1800):
        deny(f"authoritative validation cannot run: command {index} timeout_seconds must be 1..1800")
    if any(re.search(p, command, re.I) for p in blocked_patterns):
        deny(f"authoritative validation blocked unsafe command {index}")

    try:
        p = subprocess.run(
            command,
            shell=True,
            cwd=wd,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        exit_code = p.returncode
        stdout = p.stdout[-12000:]
        stderr = p.stderr[-12000:]
        timed_out = False
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as ex:
        exit_code = None
        stdout = (ex.stdout or "")[-12000:] if isinstance(ex.stdout, str) else ""
        stderr = (ex.stderr or "")[-12000:] if isinstance(ex.stderr, str) else ""
        timed_out = True

    passed = (not timed_out) and exit_code == expected
    if not passed:
        overall = "FAIL"

    results.append({
        "command": command,
        "expected_exit_code": expected,
        "exit_code": exit_code,
        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "passed": passed,
        "stdout_tail": stdout,
        "stderr_tail": stderr,
    })

source_root_raw = ((intake.get("source") or {}).get("source_root") or ".")
source_root = (wd / source_root_raw).resolve()
try:
    source_root.relative_to(wd)
except Exception:
    deny("authoritative validation cannot run: intake source_root escapes workspace")

scope = {
    "status": "UNAVAILABLE",
    "source_root": source_root_raw,
    "changed_files": [],
    "violations": [],
}

git_probe = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "-C", str(source_root), "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"],
    text=True,
    capture_output=True,
)
if git_probe.returncode == 0:
    git_root = pathlib.Path(git_probe.stdout.strip()).resolve()
    try:
        git_root_rel = git_root.relative_to(wd)
    except Exception:
        deny("authoritative validation cannot run: git root escapes workspace")

    status = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(git_root), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    if status.returncode != 0:
        deny("authoritative validation cannot run: git status failed")

    changed = []
    for line in status.stdout.splitlines():
        if len(line) < 4:
            continue
        path_text = line[3:]
        if " -> " in path_text:
            path_text = path_text.split(" -> ", 1)[1]
        rel_to_workspace = (git_root_rel / pathlib.PurePosixPath(path_text)).as_posix()
        if rel_to_workspace.startswith(".agents_tmp/"):
            continue
        changed.append(rel_to_workspace)

    def path_matches(entry, path):
        return (entry.endswith("/") and path.startswith(entry)) or path == entry

    violations = [
        path for path in changed
        if not any(path_matches(entry, path) for entry in mutable)
        or any(path_matches(entry, path) for entry in forbidden)
    ]
    scope = {
        "status": "PASS" if not violations else "FAIL",
        "source_root": source_root_raw,
        "git_root": git_root_rel.as_posix() if git_root_rel.as_posix() != "." else ".",
        "changed_files": changed,
        "violations": violations,
    }
    if violations:
        overall = "FAIL"
else:
    scope["status"] = "FAIL"
    scope["violations"] = ["git scope check unavailable"]
    overall = "FAIL"

record = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "plan_sha256": plan_sha,
    "overall": overall,
    "scope": scope,
    "commands": results,
}
tmpdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
temp_path = out_path.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
temp_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
temp_path.replace(out_path)

print(json.dumps({
    "decision": "allow",
    "reason": f"authoritative validation completed with overall={overall}; reviewer must inspect VALIDATION.json"
}))
'"'"')' || exit 2
